## Description

After a completed visit, a consenting patient gets a link to a two-question survey (rating and comment). The owner sees results per doctor and per month.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The link carries no patient data and expires after 14 days.
- [ ] **AC2.** Results with fewer than 5 responses are not shown per doctor.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
